description: Watch an app, a set of competitors or a set of keywords; significant changes become events (get_events, webhooks, daily email). kind app {app}: new versions, metadata and price changes, featuring, rating drops, review and ratings spikes, chart entries. kind competitor_set {competitors, app?}: the same for every competitor. kind keyword {terms, store or app}: the app's rank moves per term and new apps in the top N. Watched apps count against the plan's watch limit, keyword watches use one keyword slot per term × store × country; over a limit nothing changes (plan_limit). With id, changes that watch instead (send only what changes; settings are merged; active=false pauses it). Cost: 0 credits.

active.description: false pauses the watch, true resumes it

app.description: Any app id, bundle id, package, store URL or name. kind app: the app (required); competitor_set: your own app (optional); keyword: the app whose ranks to report (optional)

competitors.description: kind competitor_set: the apps to watch (any identifiers), up to 50

countries.description: Two-letter country codes to watch in (default ['us'])

event_types.description: Only these event types (default: every type of the kind)

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

id.description: Watch id to change (from list_watches). Omit to create a watch

kind.description: 'app' (one app), 'competitor_set' (several apps) or 'keyword' (search terms). Required when creating

settings.description: Thresholds: significance (0–1, default 0.5, minimum for an event), rank_move (default 5), keyword_top_n (10), chart_top_n (100), rating_drop (stars over 7 days, 0.1), spike_factor (3), email_digest (true), depth and cadence_minutes (keyword watches)

depth.description: Keyword watches: results kept per ranking (Apple ≤ 250, Play ≤ 30).

email_digest.description: Include in the daily email digest. Default: true.

significance.description: Minimum significance for an event: Jev's probability that an analyst would want the alert (AI on), or a fixed per-type score. Default: 0.5.

store.description: 'apple', 'play' or 'both' (keyword watches without app; default both). Also disambiguates app inputs

terms.description: kind keyword: search terms, e.g. ['habit tracker', 'streaks']

name: watch
title: Watch
